credits_spent: free plan, no card; the AI builder ran once
failures: P7: No full-resolution view. The gallery photographs are served as 394x587 stock files and the largest image anywhere on the site is 632 px wide; clicking a photograph opens the series page, not a viewer or the original file.
notes: SITE123 now runs a prompt-based AI builder behind its three-step signup: pick the website type, enter category, name and a description, sign up with Google, then the builder writes the site. It used the whole brief — the tagline 'Harbours, interiors, and quiet portraits — light held still', nine titled photographs, the three series pages (Harbour Light, Interiors, Quiet Portraits with six photographs each and print labels), an about page with a two-paragraph biography and a contact form with name, email and message. The build took about two minutes and was published free on a site123.me subdomain, with a SITE123 badge bar fixed at the bottom of every page. The photographs are stock; the AI wrote the copy, not the images. A description field is optional: there is a 'Let us generate it for you' button that writes one from category and name.
